Devkitty 1.0.0 (build 422)

Saved tabs and terminals

  • Only one copy of Devkitty runs at a time. Opening a second copy (for example one still in Downloads) brings the open one forward, so two copies can no longer overwrite each other's saved tabs.
  • After a restart, one damaged saved tab no longer loses every tab. The other tabs come back, and Devkitty keeps a copy of the old save file.
  • If another copy wrote the save file and a save would drop two or more workspaces, Devkitty first keeps a copy of the old file.

Right-to-left text

  • Card titles, descriptions, notes, Board AI and Quick AI chats follow each paragraph's own writing direction: Hebrew or Arabic aligns right, English aligns left.
  • The terminal draws Hebrew and Arabic right to left. Turn it off in Settings > Terminal or in Cmd+P.
  • Known limit: inside a right-to-left word, the cursor can sit on the wrong letter. Selection and copied text are correct.

Board and Board AI

  • Board AI can read Devkitty's own diagnostics (error codes, restore records, crash summaries) to explain problems. It never sees names, paths or terminal text. Turn it off in Settings > Board or in Cmd+P.
  • Drop files and folders from Finder onto a card's Files section.
  • A new card icon also changes its workspace tab icon.

Browser

  • Google Meet tabs reopened after a restart are no longer kept silent. A tab with a live microphone or camera is never kept silent.
  • Darkening light web pages is off for everyone. Turn it on in Settings > Browser or in Cmd+P.
